## Details
### **SW-REQ-LORA-001** — Transmit Raw Byte Payload

- **Description:** The LoRa library shall transmit caller-supplied raw byte payloads over the RYLR896 radio.
- **Rationale:** Telem_lib provides serialized telemetry bytes; lora_lib is responsible for getting them on the air.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-003
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-LORA-002** — Payload Content Opacity

- **Description:** The LoRa library shall not interpret or modify the content of caller-supplied payload bytes.
- **Rationale:** PM decision: lora_lib is a transport-only driver; telem_lib owns packet structure and content.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-003
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-LORA-003** — Sustain 2 Hz Send Cadence

- **Description:** The LoRa library shall complete each transmit call within the period required to sustain 2 Hz downlink.
- **Rationale:** Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-019; driver send time must not stall the 2 Hz telemetry app.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-019
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-LORA-004** — AT-Command Configuration Interface

- **Description:** The LoRa library shall configure the radio address, network ID, frequency, spreading factor, and bandwidth at initialization.
- **Rationale:** RYLR896 requires AT-command configuration of these parameters before payload transmission is reliable.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-003
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-LORA-005** — Power-On Self-Test Probe

- **Description:** The LoRa library shall probe the RYLR896 with an AT command and verify an OK response at startup.
- **Rationale:** Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-029; POST must confirm the radio module is responsive before flight.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-029
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-LORA-006** — Continuous Health Reporting

- **Description:** The LoRa library shall report a health status reflecting the most recent transmit and module-response outcome.
- **Rationale:** Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-031 and SW-REQ-SYS-061; ongoing health observability for the radio is required.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-031
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-LORA-007** — Unhealthy on Send Failure

- **Description:** The LoRa library shall report unhealthy status when a transmit attempt fails.
- **Rationale:** Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-061; transmission failures must be surfaced via health state.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-061
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-LORA-008** — Unhealthy on Missing Module Response

- **Description:** The LoRa library shall report unhealthy status when the RYLR896 fails to respond to an AT command.
- **Rationale:** Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-061; lack of module response indicates a non-functional radio path.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-061
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-LORA-009** — Return Status on Send Failure

- **Description:** The LoRa library shall return a non-success status when a transmit call fails.
- **Rationale:** Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-036; callers must observe failure to continue operating without halting.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-036
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-LORA-010** — POSIX and Pico2 Implementations

- **Description:** The LoRa library shall provide functionally equivalent POSIX and Pico2 implementations behind one API.
- **Rationale:** Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-043; Trick simulation must exercise the same lora_lib API as flight.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-043
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-LORA-011** — Deterministic Behavior

- **Description:** The LoRa library shall produce deterministic outputs and status codes given identical inputs.
- **Rationale:** Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-044; deterministic driver behavior is required for repeatable Trick runs.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-044
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-LORA-012** — Configurable UART Baud Rate

- **Description:** The LoRa library shall accept a UART baud rate as a configuration parameter at initialization.
- **Rationale:** PM decision: baud rate is configurable to match RYLR896 module settings without code changes.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-003
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1
